request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT

layers.text: Make it a giant mothership: enlarge the hull until it touches the left and right edges and make the disc twice as thick, with two rows of magenta lights and a gunmetal belt between; replace the glass dome with a chrome command tower of two stacked rings with lit magenta windows and a mast with antennas; make the magenta beam port underneath larger. No pilot, no legs; empty space stays under it. Keep the colours, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
